title: Mall World Questionnaire
content: Greetings! If anyone has time or interest in answering some questions (shown below) pertaining to Mall World, please reply with your responses or send me a message. I'll explain the purpose of the questionnaire at the end of this post. TYIA to anyone willing to participate! \*\*\*\* **Questions:** 1. What fascinates you most about being a part of the Mall World community? (More than one answer can be applicable, of course) * Being able to recall your own dream memories better by reading posts by others * Feeling like you finally have an outlet to discuss dreams with people that understand * Wondering the possibilities of a "bigger picture" in all of this / Seeking theories for what it all means 2. Have your dreams / dream locations / memories of dreams stayed consistent throughout your life? Have you experienced a hiatus? Are you visiting new locations as you get older? 3. Do you feel that certain dream locations provoke specific emotions? Please provide some examples if possible. For instance, in my "mall world" I almost always feel excited/curious/promiscuous but in my "school world" I feel anxious/nervous/paranoid. 4. Do you ever try talking to strangers in dreams ABOUT being in a dream? If so, have you had any conversations worth mentioning? **Purpose of Questions:** I've been working on Mall World material that expands outside of our Reddit community- mainly in the form of YouTube videos. My own curiosity and fascination has grown exponentially since I found this sub a few years ago. I'm sure I'm not alone when I say that I did a ton of digging to find this group in the first place- googling stuff, trying to find relative podcasts or videos etc. but there really isn't much out there. Some content I started working on / recording includes: * Deep dives into specific dream locations by reviewing bits and pieces from our very own posts- finding similarities in layouts, sightings, emotions & activities. Using AI imaging to help bring our visions to life. * Discussing philosophies, theories & conspiracies regarding shared dream spaces * Creating guided meditations / visualizations to \*hopefully\* induce a lucid dream state targeting specific dream locations At this time I only have 1 video "live"- which was posted in this sub about a year ago. If there is actual interest, I'll continue to post more. I'll take any feedback, requests, ideas etc. Thank you! &#x200B; &#x200B; &#x200B; &#x200B;
